name: endroit/rooms
description: Scoped shared and personal continuity for an Endroit Home.

capabilities.description: Resolve or create the one Home or Desk Room that owns durable work.
Capture and route explicitly deferred matter in its owning Room.
Record one accepted decision in its owning Room.
Inspect Room contracts and propose bounded repairs without implicit cleanup.
Archive or restore inactive Room material while preserving one durable copy.

skills.description: Use when durable work needs one explicit shared Home or personal Desk owner.
Use when deferred matter should be captured or reviewed without starting work.
Use when an accepted decision should become a durable Room Document.
Use when Room structure or ownership needs a read-only hygiene inspection.
Use when inactive Room material must be archived or restored explicitly.

commands.description: Resolve or create a scoped Room.
Capture or review Room Inbox matter.
Archive or restore Room material explicitly.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one atomic Home or Desk Room.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List Rooms across Home and the current Desk.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check Room identity, layout and ownership without mutation.
